title: Spending and balance
summary: Each movement goes in a list; a loop computes the balance.
done: You saw a list and a “for each” loop.

hello.text: In level 2, you can also spend. Click **New** to see what changed.

push.text: We no longer add to the total: we write each **movement** at the end of a list.

spend.text: Spending is written as a negative: 0 − amount.

loop.text: The [for each] loop goes over each movement and adds it to the total, which starts from 0.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Add money twice: the loop lights up once per movement.
watch.hint: Type a number in the preview, then tap “+ Add”.

toast.text: Show a short message when you spend.
toast.hint: Put it in “when Spend is clicked”.

red.text: Change the colour of the total in “show the balance”.
red.hint: With an [if], you can even make it red when it is below 0.

reset.text: Add a “Clear all” button that empties the list.
reset.hint: [set moves to] [create empty list], then call “show the balance”.
